body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature affected by one of your Hex Rites deals damage.

body.label: Effect
body.html: The triggering creature becomes Exposed. If it is Possessed, it also burns 1 die.

surges.html: A second creature linked to the original target within 3 units receives one non-damage benefit or penalty of this Reaction.
Spend 1 Mana. If the triggering creature is Possessed, it burns 1 additional die; otherwise it suffers -1 Defense until its next turn.
